import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class ModInt {
        int x;
        ModInt() { x = 0; }
        ModInt(int sig) { 
            int sigt = sig % MOD; 
            if (sigt < 0) sigt += MOD; 
            x = sigt; 
        }
        ModInt(long sig) { 
            int sigt = (int)(sig % MOD); 
            if (sigt < 0) sigt += MOD; 
            x = sigt; 
        }
        int get() { return x; }
        
        ModInt add(ModInt that) { 
            ModInt res = new ModInt(this.x); 
            res.x += that.x; 
            if (res.x >= MOD) res.x -= MOD; 
            return res; 
        }
        ModInt sub(ModInt that) { 
            ModInt res = new ModInt(this.x); 
            res.x = (res.x + MOD - that.x) % MOD; 
            return res; 
        }
        ModInt mul(ModInt that) { 
            return new ModInt((long)this.x * that.x % MOD); 
        }
        
        ModInt addInPlace(ModInt that) { 
            this.x += that.x; 
            if (this.x >= MOD) this.x -= MOD; 
            return this; 
        }
        ModInt subInPlace(ModInt that) { 
            this.x = (this.x + MOD - that.x) % MOD; 
            return this; 
        }
        ModInt mulInPlace(ModInt that) { 
            this.x = (int)((long)this.x * that.x % MOD); 
            return this; 
        }
    }

    static class Matrix {
        ModInt[][] v;
        ModInt[][] w;
        int rows, cols;
        
        Matrix() {}
        
        Matrix(int n, int m) {
            v = new ModInt[n][m];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    v[i][j] = new ModInt(0);
                }
            }
            rows = n;
            cols = m;
        }
        
        int height() { return rows; }
        int width() { return cols; }
        
        ModInt at(int i, int j) { return v[i][j]; }
        ModInt at(int i, int j, ModInt val) { 
            v[i][j] = val; 
            return val; 
        }
        
        static Matrix identity(int n) {
            Matrix A = new Matrix(n, n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                A.at(i, i, new ModInt(1));
            }
            return A;
        }
        
        static Matrix identity(Matrix A) { 
            return identity(A.height()); 
        }
        
        Matrix mul(Matrix B) {
            int n = this.rows, m = B.cols, p = B.rows;
            assert p == this.cols;
            ModInt[][] result = new ModInt[n][m];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    result[i][j] = new ModInt(0);
                }
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < p; k++) {
                        ModInt val = this.v[i][k].mul(B.v[k][j]);
                        result[i][j].x = (result[i][j].x + val.x) % MOD;
                        if (result[i][j].x >= MOD) result[i][j].x -= MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            Matrix res = new Matrix(n, m);
            res.v = result;
            return res;
        }
        
        Matrix mulInPlace(Matrix B) {
            Matrix res = this.mul(B);
            this.v = res.v;
            this.rows = res.rows;
            this.cols = res.cols;
            return this;
        }
    }
    
    static Matrix pow(Matrix t, long k) {
        Matrix A = new Matrix(t.height(), t.width());
        for (int i = 0; i < t.height(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < t.width(); j++) {
                A.v[i][j] = t.v[i][j];
            }
        }
        Matrix B = Matrix.identity(t.height());
        
        while (k > 0) {
            if ((k & 1) == 1) {
                B = B.mul(A);
            }
            A = A.mul(A);
            k >>= 1;
        }
        return B;
    }
    
    static Matrix getRotateMatrix(int k, int t) {
        t = (t % k + k) % k;
        Matrix A = new Matrix(k + 3, k + 3);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            A.at(i, (i + t) % k, new ModInt(1));
        }
        A.at(k, k, new ModInt(1));
        A.at(k + 1, k + 1, new ModInt(1));
        A.at(k + 2, k + 2, new ModInt(1));
        return A;
    }
    
    static Matrix getSingletonMatrix(int k, int j) {
        assert 0 <= j && j < k;
        Matrix A = new Matrix(k + 3, k + 3);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            if (i != j) {
                A.at(i, i, new ModInt(1));
            }
        }
        A.at(k + 1, k + 1, new ModInt(1));
        A.at(k + 2, k + 2, new ModInt(1));
        
        A.at(k, k + 1, new ModInt(1));
        A.at(j, k + 1, new ModInt(MOD - 1));
        
        A.at(k, k, new ModInt(2));
        A.at(j, k, new ModInt(MOD - 1));
        
        A.at(k, j, new ModInt(1));
        
        return A;
    }
    
    static int s_k(int k, long j) {
        long t = j;
        int u = 0;
        while (t > 0) {
            u = (u + (int)(t % k)) % k;
            t /= k;
        }
        return u;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        while (sc.hasNextLong()) {
            long n = sc.nextLong();
            int k = sc.nextInt();
            
            Matrix b = new Matrix(1, k + 3);
            b.at(0, k, new ModInt(1));
            b.at(0, k + 1, new ModInt(1));
            b.at(0, k + 2, new ModInt(1));
            
            long powk = 1;
            int digits = 0;
            while (powk <= n / k) {
                powk *= k;
                ++digits;
            }
            
            Matrix[] P = new Matrix[digits + 1];
            P[0] = getSingletonMatrix(k, 0);
            for (int i = 1; i <= digits; i++) {
                P[i] = Matrix.identity(k + 3);
                for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                    P[i] = P[i].mul(P[i-1]);
                    P[i] = P[i].mul(getRotateMatrix(k, -1));
                }
            }
            
            long offset = 0;
            while (powk > 0) {
                int t = (int)((n - offset) / powk);
                for (int j = 0; j < t; j++) {
                    int s = s_k(k, offset);
                    b = b.mul(getRotateMatrix(k, -s));
                    b = b.mul(P[digits]);
                    b = b.mul(getRotateMatrix(k, s));
                    offset += powk;
                }
                powk /= k;
                --digits;
            }
            
            System.out.println(b.at(0, k + 1).get());
        }
    }
}
